verdicts.quote: Ordinals 1, 2 and 3 open at 09:00 UTC respectively 1, 7 and 14 UTC calendar days after the authoritative due date. ... An invoice due today or in the future is excluded.
Draft/unissued, paid, fully credited, void, written off/uncollectible, deleted, disputed or explicitly held, and invoices with a pending payment are excluded.
verdicts.missing: Whether an invoice on a payment plan stops the sequence is not stated (only generic 'explicitly held' / collection holds).

Simultaneous or repeated evaluations share the same disposition and cannot both authorize a submission for the same attempt. ... Rescheduling, restart or reactivation cannot create another accepted submission for a finalized slot.
Immediately before each dispatch authorization, apply the invoice authority's current effective policy, access, invoice revision, date, outstanding balance, hold and recipient.
On confirmed temporary non-acceptance, retry no earlier than 1 hour after the first such result and 24 hours after the second... A temporary rejection on attempt 3 ends the slot as exhausted.
verdicts.missing: No escalation to a person when sends keep failing; exhausted/failed slots are only visible as status, and provider-outage handling beyond per-attempt retry is not defined.

verdicts.quote: Invoice volume, overdue backlog, dispatch bursts, scheduling precision, storage/retention capacity, provider limits and cost ceiling are unresolved.
